title: iOS / Android share-sheet ('Share to Adaptly')
description: Register Adaptly as a share target on iOS + Android so a teacher can take a photo of a textbook page (or screenshot a BBC Bitesize article), tap Share, pick Adaptly, and land on /worksheets with the OCR-parsed text already in the topic field.
rationale: User's improvement #12 (b). The share sheet is the moment of intent on mobile — the lowest-friction generation path that exists. iOS + Android both expose this for installed PWAs via the Web Share Target API.
constraints: PWA-only — no native app build. The repo already has a manifest.json (or doesn't — confirm and add).
Web Share Target API requires a registered service worker with a fetch handler for the /share-target route.
Privacy: shared content is processed client-side; never uploaded as a separate doc. OCR runs in Tesseract.js as elsewhere.
steps: Audit: grep `manifest.json`, `service-worker`, `serviceWorker` in client/. Confirm if a PWA scaffold exists.
If no manifest: add client/public/manifest.webmanifest with icons + name + start_url + share_target spec:
share_target: { action: '/share-target', method: 'POST', enctype: 'multipart/form-data', params: { title, text, url, files: [{ name: 'image', accept: ['image/*', '.pdf'] }] } }.
Service worker: register one if absent (Vite plugin: vite-plugin-pwa). On /share-target POST: deserialise the multipart, persist to IndexedDB under a one-shot key, navigate to /worksheets?shared=1.

Worksheets.tsx: when ?shared=1 is present on mount, read from IndexedDB, OCR any image/PDF via the lazy-loaded Tesseract worker (already used by Differentiate), pre-fill subject (best-guess from text), topic (first 80 chars), additionalInstructions (full OCR'd text capped at 4kb).
Add an 'Install Adaptly' prompt in Settings explaining how to add to home screen on iOS Safari + Android Chrome (different flows).
- client/src/__tests__/share-target.test.ts — covers manifest schema validity, IndexedDB hand-off shape, query-string trigger.
do_not_touch: WeekAhead handoff in Worksheets.tsx (Phase A · PR-4) — share-target is a separate one-shot useEffect; do not interleave
acceptance_criteria: After installing as PWA on iOS + Android, sharing an image or text to Adaptly opens /worksheets with the topic pre-filled.
Sharing a PDF triggers OCR fallback.
Manifest validates against W3C web app manifest schema.
Tests pass; pnpm check + build pass.
verification: Manual: install PWA on real iOS + Android device; share an image; confirm landing experience.
